name: ShowSpectators
description: Shows you who's spectating your stream under the screenshare panel
author: domi.btnr

changes.title: New options
items: Prefer it short? Turn on the new "Compact Mode" option to list spectators in a single sentence. Clicking a name in the panel opens their profile, just like the avatars do
Watching someone else's stream? The panel now shows who else is watching. Don't need it? Turn off the new "Show Watched Stream's Spectators" option

changes.title: Improved
items: Rewrote the plugin from the ground up, making it lighter and less likely to break when Discord updates
Spectators now show their server avatars

changes.title: Fixed
items: The spectators panel now shows up right away when you reload Discord or turn the plugin on while you're already in a call
